theme: Lake Superior seiche oscillation becomes a counterweight grappler: alternating wave lobes grow into bracing arms and a hinged wrestling body.

evolution_design.regional_evidence: NOAA explains seiches as standing oscillations in a basin following wind or pressure disturbances. The Lake Superior reserve monitoring metadata describes seiche-driven flow reversals in the St Louis River estuary.
evolution_design.original_invention: The wave wrestler is an original creature built around alternating mass. It does not claim tides or perpetual motion, and no magical river portal is involved.

body_growth.body: One broad teetering water lobe with a low central pebble-colored face and two unequal side lobes, one lifted and one compressed.
body_growth.silhouette: Off-center seesaw bean with one high and one low side.

body_growth.body: The side lobes become thick opposed forearms around a squat central body; broad heel-like flukes brace the backward swing.
body_growth.silhouette: Broad wave-arms and two short grounding heels; center now lifted.

body_growth.body: Two heavy curl-knuckles connect to a low muscular central node through solid S-bent shoulders. A broad saddle tail serves as a counterweight and two feet brace a grappling stance.
body_growth.silhouette: Wide grappler with two large curled fists and a low saddle-tail counterweight, whole body continuous.

silhouette_concept: Off-center seesaw bean with one high and one low side. → Broad wave-arms and two short grounding heels; center now lifted. → Wide grappler with two large curled fists and a low saddle-tail counterweight, whole body continuous.
habitat: Shallow lake mouths, sheltered coves and exposed shore basins.

proposed_routes.placement: Existing lake-facing fishing cove; ordinary encounter without changing waterfall story.
proposed_routes.status: encounter proposal only; no map or story mutation

sources.title: NOAA, What is a seiche?
sources.supports: Standing basin oscillations after meteorological forcing.

sources.title: Lake Superior NERR, Water-quality monitoring metadata
sources.supports: Lake Superior seiche effects and estuary flow reversals.

nonduplication: Unlike F045 Devils Kettle legendary, no portal, disappearing waterfall, kettle shape or dual-current supernatural head. Unlike F003 skipping-ray, no hydrofoil fish anatomy.
